hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && { if git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git pull --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null && echo "[auto-sync] pulled latest"; else echo "[auto-sync] skipped pull (uncommitted changes)"; fi; echo '--- STATUS.md ---'; sed -n '1,40p' STATUS.md 2>/dev/null; }; true
